integrity: The proof uses an explicit real Gram matrix whose off-diagonal support is exactly the graph and an explicit zero forcing sequence. The standard maximum-nullity inequality then closes both parameters exactly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for a direct product of at least three fields.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric matrices; other characteristics can change the Gram-matrix argument.
The finite verifier corroborates selected ranks and small exhaustive cases but does not replace the symbolic proof.
Terminology for the same subset-intersection graph varies across the graph-theory literature, leaving a residual indexing risk.
title: Zero forcing and minimum rank of ideal-intersection graphs of products of fields
